steps.result: written to DataHub as an incident

summary: Use dbt regions (gold, 98.46) as the region reference table, Snowflake PRODUCT_CATEGORIES (gold, 92.21) as the product category reference table, and dbt order_details (gold, 98.46) as the sales fact joining them. incident.title: TrustBoard: an agent declined to use b2fd91.order_entry_db.order_entry.product_categories
incident.body:
An automated agent was asked to: Build a regional sales breakdown by product category for the sales team, using the regions and product category reference tables

It consulted the TrustBoard score for this dataset over MCP and declined to use it. Reason given:

Trust score 39.75 (at-risk tier), below the silver minimum required for building a sales reporting pipeline.

This is real work that did not happen because of the state of this data. Raising the dataset's trust score clears it.
